Therefore, the benchmark environment must maintain constant clock speeds. Every benchmark iteration must utilize identical batch sizes to maintain benchmark consistency. The benchmark reveals that memory bandwidth is the primary bottleneck in this decode benchmark. Consequently, optimizing the benchmark involves minimizing KV cache movement. A robust benchmark must also account for quantization effects during the benchmark execution. Ultimately, the Gemma B70 decode benchmark serves as a critical benchmark for scaling large language model inference.
